HOWEVER, the firewall question -- is the claimed DIVERGENCE-from-convention real and field-redirecting? -- must be answered NO-as-discovery / YES-only-as-casting-dependent-hypothesis. Combined with the E024 mis-attribution (it types bulk/CFT geometry, not GR directly; no direct GR->entanglement edge exists) and the fact that one endpoint is not a real closure card, the card is DEFENSIBLE for its PRIMARY structural claim but OVER-REACHES in the secondary/divergence framing. Verdict: contested/casting-dependent on the divergence; firm on the primary required-structure. Apply the five hardening fixes before any field-redirecting framing.
